The '''Kavetsian Languages''' are a branch of the [[Zhensanovian Languages]] associated in source material with the southwestern forests of the [[Union of Zhensanov]].

The source describes Kavetsian languages as more analytic than some other Zhensanovian branches, with extensive verb prefixes, a smaller case system than Toramdic, hissing consonant sounds, and no grammatical gender.

== Canon Limits ==

This draft preserves only the linguistic features and broad source region. It does not establish a forest polity, legal minority status, or military role for Kavetsian speakers.
